findings.message: This app requires environment variables that have no value yet: STORAGE_TYPE, TWENTY_API_URL. Set them in the application's Configuration screen before deploying.
Deployz ignores the deployment files in this repository (packages/twenty-docker/k8s/terraform/main.tf). It builds the Dockerfile and provisions the infrastructure itself.
